name: Example Skill
description: Demonstrates the repository structure for GitHub-installed skills.

name: WeChat Miniapp Dev
description: Guides one-stop WeChat Mini Program creation, iteration, documentation, checks, and release preparation.

name: A-Share Core Stock Analysis
description: Analyzes institutional behavior of Chinese A-share core holdings using market regime, index leadership, ETF flow, relative strength, chip distribution, institution cost zone, and national-team logic instead of literal main-capital flow.

name: Novel Atlas
description: Turns a full novel into one ultra-high-resolution atlas image holding its timeline, cast and irreversible events: designs a blueprint of tiled zones, writes and voice-edits the label copy before measuring it, splits a panel by a seam into two complete scenes where a second scene is needed, generates one image per zone, then composites tiles and text into a single picture locally.

name: XHS Story
description: Turns a real idea-to-shipped process into a 7-page Xiaohongshu (rednote) image carousel with a paste-ready caption, structured as 起承转合. Recovers authentic detail from session transcripts and renders all Chinese text with CSS + headless Chrome instead of an image model.

name: Humanizer ZH
description: Edits Chinese prose to remove filler, repetition and template phrasing while keeping facts, hedging and the author's voice. Vendored from op7418/Humanizer-zh (MIT) unmodified; novel-atlas uses its plate-scale subset through references/copy-voice.md.

name: Promo Atlas
description: Turns a launch brief into one persona-by-scenario master board plus per-channel deliverables (Xiaohongshu carousel, long image, Douyin vertical, WeChat Moments square, Weibo banner). Copy tone is agreed before any caption is written; every cell is gated on a sourced fact by lint_density.py; delivery pages land on exact platform pixels; finance and insurance builds carry a persistent risk disclosure band and prohibited-claim blocking.
